==Events==
*A group of [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] crash-land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Holador]]. Their [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] fails, and they eventually regress to a tribal society.<ref name="SIII 12">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Strike III}}</ref>
